## W17 Results and business value

**Calculation rules**

Case-processing hours saved = comparable baseline case effort minus pilot case effort, including failed attempts and fallback. Percentage reduction uses baseline case effort as denominator. Report accepted, refused and abandoned cases against all attempts.

Net recurring hours saved = case-processing saving minus incremental recurring oversight versus baseline for the same period. Pilot net hours also deduct one-time setup. Keep tool fees and other costs separate; released capacity is not automatically cash saved.

**Case saving and net benefit**

Baseline oversight; pilot oversight; increment; one-time setup; tool/other cost; units/period. Mark net benefit incomplete if a required cost is unmeasured.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Limitations and decision implication**

Consider variability, reviewer burden and sample size. A failed mandatory gate cannot be averaged away by benefit.
